scope: READ_ONLY_CURRENT_FUNCTIONS_QUEUE_AND_CRON; no tick invocation or hosted mutation

definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_dispatch(p_need_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT statement_timestamp())
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  insert into private.dispatch_schedule (need_id, next_run_at)
  values (p_need_id, p_at)
  on conflict (need_id) do update
    set next_run_at = least(private.dispatch_schedule.next_run_at, excluded.next_run_at),
        updated_at = statement_timestamp();
$function$

findings.finding: Use locked_until for lease aggregation; lease_until is not a dispatch_schedule column.
No due or currently leased dispatch rows in the snapshot. Three active Cron jobs each have 1440 succeeded/0 failed/0 unfinished runs in the rolling 24-hour interval.

marketplace_tick calls expiry, dispatch, completion, export maintenance, retention maintenance and AI sweep in one SQL function/transaction. Claimed Need/queue locks persist until transaction completion.

dispatch_tick checks the 40-second budget only between processed tasks. It does not bound profile requeue, successful-claim scanning, or a single dispatch_next_wave. Claim scanning stops after p_batch successful claims rather than a total candidate count/time bound.

Queue claim uses Need-before-queue row locks and SKIP LOCKED; skipped queue subtransaction releases its unsuccessful Need lock. Dispatch has per-transaction notify budget and delay/backoff. Opportunity uniqueness is per worker/Need/revision, with zero existing duplicate groups.

In the non-remote final branch, inserted=0 writes dispatch_rounds.stop_reason=NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATES but returned STOPPED JSON has no reason. dispatch_tick falls back to STOPPED; one current schedule row stores generic STOPPED. No proof of task loss, duplicate delivery or stuck work follows from this alone.

limits: Read-only observation is not concurrency/load testing.
Cron success does not prove provider receipt, Android notification delivery or full task lifecycle.
Current transaction boundaries remain a scaling/recovery item; no current overload incident was established.
No source changes, migration, external message, provider call, task mutation or deletion was performed.
